scope.evidence_basis: Actual author reconstruction: Reproduced the dense-set diagonal and three-term finite-net estimate for every derivative family. Passing FToC along a coordinate segment identifies the limits as first and second derivatives. Checked min(a,b)<=a^(1-theta)b^theta with theta=beta/alpha; applying it to second-derivative differences produces convergence only when beta<alpha. Fixed-pair quotients preserve the alpha bound in the limit. The separate exhaustion argument retains nested subsequences; its diagonal converges on every fixed compact set, without a global estimate.
